source_name: Fiscal Z State Transition Type Controlled Codes
source_description: Governed append-only canonical Z state transition types.

code_sets.description: Initialization, atomic Z-close, and controlled manual Z-counter reset transition identities.

codes.description: Explicit new-scope zero initialization or verified legacy import.
Atomic fiscal-period close that advances the Z counter and accumulated grand total.
Explicit authorized manual reset that sets the Z counter to zero, advances the Reset Counter, and preserves accumulated grand total.

notes: Manual Z-counter reset is an explicitly invoked, authorized, immutable transition and is never scheduled automatically.
